show_title: Invest Like the Best with Patrick O'Shaughnessy
title: Strauss Zelnick - Playing to Your Strengths - [Invest Like the Best, EP.347]
summary: Take-Two is a sophisticated top-tier developer, publisher and marketer of interactive entertainment that owns Rockstar Games and 2K. Strauss' passion for entertainment led him strong and fast into the industry as he worked his way from sales to CEO and transitioned from motion pictures to gaming. Today, we cover his approach to staying on the cutting edge of media development, unlocking talent and potential in those around you and becoming the leader you are meant to be.
